questions.question: The India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) was announced at which summit?
questions.explanation: IMEC — a rail-shipping corridor linking India, Middle East and Europe — was unveiled during India's G20 Presidency at the New Delhi Summit (Sept 2023), with an MoU signed by India, US, UAE, Saudi Arabia, EU and others.

questions.question: The 106th Constitutional Amendment Act relates to:
questions.explanation: The 106th Amendment (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, 2023) provides one-third reservation for women in Lok Sabha and State Assemblies. EWS was the 103rd Amendment.

questions.question: The 'State of the World's Forests' report is released by:
questions.explanation: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) publishes the State of the World's Forests (SOFO) biennially, along with the Global Forest Resources Assessment.

questions.question: 'PM-SURAJ' portal, launched in 2024, is aimed at:
questions.explanation: PM Social Utthan evam Rozgar Adharit Jankalyan (PM-SURAJ) provides credit support to marginalised communities including SCs, OBCs and sanitation workers. Rooftop solar is PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.

questions.question: Which country hosted COP28 of the UNFCCC in 2023, where the 'UAE Consensus' on transitioning away from fossil fuels was adopted?
questions.explanation: COP28 was held in Dubai, UAE. It concluded the first Global Stocktake and called for 'transitioning away from fossil fuels in energy systems'. COP27 was in Egypt; COP29 in Azerbaijan.

questions.question: 'Exercise Vajra Prahar' is a joint military exercise between India and:
questions.explanation: Vajra Prahar is the India-US Special Forces exercise. Yudh Abhyas is the army exercise with the US; Indra with Russia; Shakti with France; Dharma Guardian with Japan.

questions.question: Under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana, households can receive:
options: Subsidy for rooftop solar and up to 300 units of free electricity monthly
questions.explanation: Launched Feb 2024: rooftop solar for 1 crore households with central subsidy (up to ₹78,000 for 3 kW) and up to 300 units free electricity per month.

questions.question: Which grouping consists of India, Israel, UAE and USA?
questions.explanation: I2U2 (India, Israel, UAE, USA), formed 2021, focuses on water, energy, transportation, space, health, and food security investments — dubbed the 'West Asian Quad'.

questions.question: India's rank/performance context: the 'Logistics Performance Index' is published by:
questions.explanation: The World Bank publishes the LPI; India ranked 38/139 in 2023, improving on the back of PM Gati Shakti and the National Logistics Policy (2022).

questions.question:
The 'Colombo Security Conclave' includes which of the following countries?
1. India
2. Sri Lanka
3. Maldives
4. Mauritius
questions.explanation: The Colombo Security Conclave (maritime & security cooperation grouping) includes India, Sri Lanka, Maldives and Mauritius as members, with Bangladesh and Seychelles as observers.
